description.zh: 新建的应用描述，最多支持256个字符
description.en: The description of the new application. The description can be up to 256 characters in length.

description.zh:
手动设置订阅ID(不指定则由服务端创建）

1. 只能包含小写字母，数字和下划线(_)

1. 必须以小写字母开头

1. 名称长度限制在4-40个字符之间
description.en:
The subscription ID that you manually specify. If you do not specify this parameter, the server automatically generates one.

1. The ID can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).

1. The ID must start with a lowercase letter.

1. The ID must be 4 to 40 characters in length.
